text:
sara: Alert: nightly evals flagged a small but consistent regression on prompt set 'summarize-150' — ~6 examples flipped vs baseline. CC @devon @alex

devon: seeing it. traces show tokenization divergence before model run.

alex: Did we change sentencepiece/tokenizer deps recently? I thought we pinned versions.

sara: no recorded model or prompt changes. failures start after yesterday's image rollout.

ci-bot: Nightly eval job 2026-06-... failed: 6 diffs. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1762509876 (attached).

linh: quick check: on the failing runner, run `python -c "import sentencepiece as sp; print(sp.__version__)"`

miguel: ran on runner-a: 0.1.97 ; runner-b: 0.1.96 — mismatch.

devon: that explains it. minor sentencepiece versions can change subtokenization for edge cases.

alex: how did two runners get different wheels? our image build pins, but we use docker layer cache during parallel builds.

sara: hypothesis: concurrent builds reused an older wheel layer that slipped into the image tag we pushed.

linh: repro: with 0.1.96, `sp.encode("U.S.") -> [23, 45, 112]`; with 0.1.97 `sp.encode("U.S.") -> [23, 210, 112]`. border-case token boundaries.

miguel: temp fix: force-unify by `pip install --upgrade --no-cache-dir sentencepiece==0.1.97` on all runners and rebuild image.

alex: +1, do that and rerun the nightly.

ci-bot: manual override triggered: rebuild image with cleared cache. new image pushed: sha256:aaa111.

miguel: applied pip fix to 4 runners, restarted evals — rerun shows no diffs so far. :white_check_mark:

devon: followups: 1) add a harness startup check that prints `sentencepiece.__version__` and aborts if mismatch across pool 2) pin wheel in base image and bake it into the layer 3) CI: invalidate docker cache when we bump tokenizer deps (or colocate wheel in repo).

sara: I'll open an infra ticket and assign to eng-infra for the image/pinning work. also adding eng-ml tasks for the harness check and a tiny probe test.

linh: suggestion: log `EVAL_TOKENIZER_VERSION` in job metadata so triage surfaces version mismatches immediately for future incidents.

miguel: adding a short probe set to CI that checks tokenization equivalence across two or three sample strings. will send PR.

sara: thanks all. I'll update the incident doc with steps + proof-of-fix: https://confluence/internal/evals/incident-1762509876

alex: small PSA: even tiny wheel minor bumps can change edge-case tokenization — important for deterministic evals.

sara: closing for now since rerun passed, leaving followups in tickets. thanks :heart:
